evidence.bindingRule: canonical CPE is adopted only because the complete 144-file sha256-path-nul-content-nul-v1 aggregate is byte-identical; this is component identity evidence, not M2L31 vulnerability approval

blockers.requiredDecision: PSIRT/Product Security must provide vulnerability applicability disposition and any VEX or approval. Scanner range matches alone cannot establish affected or not_affected.
